items.title: Stripe, PayPal Ventures bet on India’s Xflow to fix cross-border B2B payments
items.summary: Stripe和PayPal Ventures投资印度初创公司Xflow，旨在解决跨境B2B支付痛点。

items.title: A Meta AI security researcher said an OpenClaw agent ran amok on her inbox
items.summary: 一位Meta AI安全研究员表示，其邮箱被一个名为OpenClaw的AI代理失控干扰。

items.title: With AI, investor loyalty is (almost) dead: At least a dozen OpenAI VCs now also back Anthropic
items.summary: 随着AI发展，投资者忠诚度几乎消失，至少十几家支持OpenAI的风投现在也投资了Anthropic。

items.title: Ex-Apple team launches Acme Weather, a new take on weather forecasting
items.summary: 前苹果团队推出全新天气应用Acme Weather，带来不同的天气预报体验。
